body:
oliver: Heads up — we need to finalize signals for the sparse-key + prefix caches. Platform/Console wants per-tenant reuse by workload and eviction histograms for the new dashboard. Can runtime + infra agree on a minimum telemetry contract?

sophie: SG. Quick Q — do we want hit_rate at request-level or just 1m aggregates? I'd prefer both but start with 1m aggregates to keep cardinality down.

kevin: runtime: we can emit runtime.cache.{hit_count,miss_count,evictions,active_entries} tagged with model, tenant_id (hashed), workload. Also add prefix_cache.reuse counter (hashed prefix).

maria: infra: ingestion can handle those, but cardinality is the main risk (tenant_id + model + workload + prefix_bucket). We need explicit caps or sampling for prefix buckets.

oliver: rough worst-case estimate: 500 tenants * 30 models * 10 workloads -> ~150k series if we naively tag everything. We should plan rollups and top-k for prefixes.

sophie: Console UX wants three panels initially: 1) overall hit rate (tenant/model/workload filters), 2) eviction rate histogram, 3) top-k reused prefixes by workload. So we need both aggregated gauges and a way to surface most-reused prefixes without full cardinality.

kevin: proposed telemetry proto (we'll avoid raw prefixes — use hashes):

```json
{
  "metric": "runtime.cache.event",
  "type": "counter|gauge|histogram",
  "name": "prefix_cache.reuse",
  "tags": {
    "tenant_id": "<tenant_hash>",
    "model": "gpt-j-6b",
    "workload": "chat",
    "prefix_bucket": "sha256:abcd12"
  },
  "value": 1
}
```

kevin: We'll emit per-request counters and also publish 1m aggregated gauges (hit_rate, eviction_rate, active_entries) to make querying cheaper.

maria: infra: hashed tenant_id + hashed prefix_bucket is fine. We'll implement a pipeline stage that keeps a top-k prefix list and maps overflow to `prefix_bucket:other`. Also add an enforced tag-cardinality cap per metric name.

jess: product: add SLO ask — alert when a tenant's hit_rate drops >15% vs baseline for 5m on dedicated capacity. Want this tied to routing policy (so we can see if latency routing caused cache miss regression).

oliver: runtime: agree to add routing tag (routing_policy=latency|cost|fallback) on emissions so product can correlate. Also will emit eviction size buckets to help surface model-specific issues.

kevin: timeline proposal: spike/PR outlining fields by EOW, telemetry proto in next week, feature-flagged full prefix reporting as opt-in for a small set of tenants.

sophie: console: we'll mock panels with synthetic data this week. Ops/infra: can you ensure ingestion rewrites tenant_id -> tenant_hash and enforces prefix top-k with fallback?

maria: yes — infra will add a `prefix_topk` stage and a `hash_id` transform; we'll also add a sampling flag for high-cardinality prefix reporting. Ticket created: INF-3245.

infra-bot: INF-3245 created — "ingest: prefix top-k + tenant hashing" :white_check_mark: https://org.tasks/INF-3245

oliver: Perfect. Action items recap:
- runtime (kevin): PR to add counters + 1m aggregates + routing tag, and hash prefixes.
- infra (maria): ingest pipeline + cardinality caps + prefix_topk stage.
- console (sophie): dashboard prototype panels + filter UX.
- product (jess): SLO alert draft and routing correlation requirements.

sophie: I'll follow up with a 1-page scoping doc and mock screenshots. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: noted, will sync on INF-3245.

oliver: Great collaboration — let's keep this tight. If anyone runs into blockers ping me or drop the proto here.
